column3: Runs one script command: switch on its first letter, then the next three packed as an int (0x504c59 = "PLY" for _MPLY)
_MPLY(n,...): reads the backquote options, plays music n through FUN_0019c470 (fade-in from option 001), sets heard-music flag bit n+0xC80 for n < 0x418
Parses the current argument as a short (guess)
Music number n to the sound library's item ID: table of 132 u32 at 0x433F90 (0, then 0x01000000+n-1)
Plays music n (sound n-1 of knife1.bfsar) with volume and start offset
Splits a command's arguments: up to 20 (start, end) pairs
True if argument i is present and not empty
Evaluates argument i as an expression
Finds a picture name in the table of 23,000 names at 0x6E02A4 (records of 0x48 bytes at 0x56F830)
_STCH: set a picture on a layer (args in docs/games/tsukihime.md, "The exe")
_STZ4(layer, x0, y0, x1, y1, ms, e, f): zoom in per mille over ms
_STMA(layer, m, mode, p): start motion m from the exe's tables
Field f of motion keyframe k (0x40-byte records at 0x75CE18, 71,905)
_FADS(type, ms, rule, mode): show the staged layers (0 fade, 2 rule mask)
Loads rule mask n: the n+1-th entry after mask_top.mzp
